title: This Glove Keeps Hopping BACK 🧤
description:
If you drop something here, it hops home after you. Gloves hop after their owners up the slipway, and a dog that slips its leash rides the ferry home on its own.

Nothing I lose ever comes back. Then every street I took started ending at the slipway, and a line of damp little dots began at my own front door.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment GLOVE if you lost one and it never came back.
